title: SQL Formatter

instructions.title: How to use SQL Formatter

steps.title: Paste your SQL query
steps.description: Copy and paste your SQL query or script into the input area. The formatter accepts minified, compressed, or unformatted SQL from any database system.

steps.title: Select your SQL dialect
steps.description: Choose your database system (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL Server) for dialect-specific formatting and correct keyword recognition.

steps.title: Configure formatting options
steps.description: Customize indentation size (2 or 4 spaces), keyword casing (uppercase/lowercase), and line-break preferences to match your coding standards.

steps.title: Review the formatted output
steps.description: The formatter validates SQL syntax and displays your query with proper indentation, keyword highlighting, and improved readability — ready for code reviews and documentation.

steps.title: Copy or download the result
steps.description: Copy the formatted SQL to your clipboard for immediate use, or download it as a .sql file for storage and sharing.
